name: Glyphic Letter
summary: At Northshire Abbey, Glyphic Letter calls promising novitiates to arcane study. After serving the garrison, they are summoned upstairs to Khelden Bremen, the resident mage trainer.

sections.title: A Summons to the Arcane
sections.body:
Khelden Bremen seals Glyphic Letter with his own insignia. Apprentice spellcasters receive it after proving their discipline in Northshire Valley. The summons draws them from basic field duties into dedicated magical instruction within the abbey.

Before they take up the arcane, Bremen tests each student's resolve. Its forces are dangerous, its scrutiny unyielding, and its burdens heavy.

faq.answer: Khelden Bremen writes and seals Glyphic Letter as a summons to instruction. It directs aspiring human mages to find him in the upper chambers of Northshire Abbey for formal arcane schooling.
Khelden Bremen, the mage trainer at Northshire Abbey, seals the letter with his insignia. Garrison command hands it over after an apprentice proves their mettle against nearby vermin.

faq.q: Where do I take the Glyphic Letter?
faq.answer: Take the letter inside Northshire Abbey. Enter behind Marshal McBride, follow the left corridor, climb the stairs, and look toward the back room where Khelden Bremen teaches the arcane.

faq.q: Why does Khelden send for young mages?
faq.answer: Khelden wants to test your determination. He warns that pursuing the arcane brings fear and respect, and means challenging potent forces. He needs to know you have the will to endure that fate.

angles.text: As a Mage, this marked dispatch calls you upstairs to begin formal study of the Alliance's arcane traditions under Khelden Bremen.
As a human, you begin your service to Stormwind's magical disciplines with this summons. Northshire Abbey has sheltered arcane students throughout the kingdom's history.
